summary: Native owned-file birth identity now survives capped store publication, typed entry-result handoff and Route B; handle-bound no-replace publication/disposition and retained immutable freeze-file snapshots have deterministic native barrier coverage. Directory handles block rename of held objects but permit WRITE and child-name creation: namespace/birth/reparse/empty-directory cleanup remain HOLD. No reconstruction release or real measurement is enabled.
proved_by_native_tests: Real CreateProcessW CREATE_SUSPENDED, Job assignment before ResumeThread, restricted inherited-handle allowlist, explicit child membership/configured-limit failure exits safe under optimized Python; no security-relevant assert.

Correct membership succeeds under -O and PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1/2. Wrong existing specific Job exits 22 and missing specific Job exits 21 with zero stream bytes/work markers. Injected assignment failure terminates/reaps the suspended child before output.
External wall timeout and Job teardown; root-process allocation refusal under queried process/job committed-memory limits.

Both alternating-stream orders cross aggregate cap+1 immediately before exit: stdout including JOB_OK is 32 bytes, stderr 33 bytes, combined 65 at cap 64. Each individual stream stays below cap; at most cap bytes are retained plus one crossing byte detected. No stream disk file.

Root retains 60% of 128MiB while a descendant under the SAME specifically verified Job requests 60%. Each root actual/descendant projected process commit is below the per-process limit; their sum exceeds the Job limit. Allocation refuses, native completion-port Job memory-limit notification 10 is observed and process memory-limit notification 9 is absent.

Full-Job termination after primary exit closes explicitly inherited descendant pipe handles; observed descendant PID is no longer active. Fixed descendants use CREATE_NO_WINDOW and explicit standard-handle inheritance.
proved_by_synthetic_tests: Configured cap is forwarded harness -> route entry -> entry persistence -> actual store writer. Exact encoded-byte premeasurement, platform CRLF/escaping parity, legacy uncapped branch and every bounded short-write request remain covered.
Journal/artifact JSON prescans and output reservations precede serialization/publication; replacement peak uses actual old size plus new temporary.

Freeze requires caller root, exact observed inventory including seal/no extra/partial, trusted local caps and typed malformed JSON refusal. Windows all-artifact bytes and hashes/semantic joins use retained snapshots rather than independent pathname reloads.

Record-derived scorecard recomputation, selective project session/ingress/source paths, same-pass entry/stage/hash checkpoints and refusal terminals remain checked. Resealed altered scorecard is rejected. Full typed frozen project/session replay is a remaining gate.

Producer full typed replay uses bounded bytes from the SAME live project writer lease. Actual synthetic entry construction retains that lease outside canonical payload/digest; absent, released, wrong-path and wrong-cap leases refuse before lattice work.

Parent requires demonstrated assignment, normal exit and load_freeze; bounded producer persistence errors retain their typed refusal/checkpoint. Fresh-root external abort remains tested, populated-root finalization remains a gate.

Missing/refused/sentinel witness dependencies remain UNKNOWN; union_total and union_pairs deduplicate cross-channel (frame,pixel) pairs. Phase B and source-screenshot footprint metrics remain unavailable/null.
Ordinary legacy/non-Windows cleanup remains a sequential identity-check contract, explicitly outside the native capture ownership proof.
remaining_release_blockers: HARD HOLD: directory handles allow WRITE and child-name creation. Reparse checks and inventory observations are not atomic namespace exclusion; a hostile writer may introduce transient names. Root/staging creation before acquisition is not a proved directory birth contract, and empty-directory pathname cleanup remains race-sensitive. Held-object rename exclusion and file identity guarantees do not seal the namespace.

Native journal uses no-replace backup/new-file publication. A racing foreign final name and prior checkpoint are preserved, but the backup/gap sequence is not crash-atomic replacement; partial failure may leave the saved checkpoint name.
Full typed canonical frozen project/session replay from the retained snapshot is not implemented. The producer itself has full typed replay via the project lease, while freeze joins remain selective.
External abort on an already populated child root does not guarantee safe finalized resource-terminal freeze. Fresh-root typed abort remains covered.

Fixed harmless native Job/pipe controls are not integrated with a reconstruction worker. Public/default/CLI/direct --worker real inference remains disabled; private synthetic markers are test conventions, not an authentication boundary.

Native process/aggregate Job configuration and allocation-refusal notifications do not prove a hard observed committed-memory peak or aggregate RSS/working-set ceiling. The preserved development PeakJobMemoryUsed observation exceeded the configured limit. Production numeric caps are unchanged.

The stronger native capture contract is conditional on retained birth handles and leases. Ordinary legacy/non-Windows runner cleanup is outside it; full-path publisher/root-acquisition operations remain within the directory namespace HOLD.

proved_by_native_ownership_tests: Native file identity is obtained from retained handles using FILE_ID_INFO. Store CREATE_NEW birth file is bounded-written/flushed, no-replace-renamed and retained across typed ProjectWriteLease -> ImageDerivedEntryResult -> Route B; no pathname adoption/reopen establishes ownership.
Lease downgrade duplicates the SAME file object without WRITE rights before closing the original handle. Direct WriteFile on the retained sealed handle fails with access denied and zero bytes.

Deterministic Event barriers race same-size/same-byte file rename/replacement/write against partial cleanup, rollback, store-temp failure, project handoff and journal checkpoint update. Retained file sharing blocks mutation; cleanup uses disposition on the SAME birth handle, preserving unrelated proposals.

No-replace publication refuses a racing foreign destination and preserves its bytes. Journal backup/new-file handle renames preserve a racing foreign final name and saved previous checkpoint; journal publication is not crash-atomic.

Freeze retains all terminal-file/seal exclusion handles across bounded reads, hashes and semantic joins, borrowing invocation birth handles when supplied. Barrier replacement/write of held files and rename of held root objects fail.

An EMPTY held root cannot be renamed. Directory GENERIC_WRITE opening and child creation DO succeed; namespace_exclusive is explicitly false. Observed extra child names refuse freeze validation and survive. No reparse creation was used or reparse exclusion proven.
